title: Sync upstream RapidRAW db643b1c: Immich library, AI job tracker, new AI masks, BM3D denoise, storage page
source: CyberTimon/RapidRAW main at db643b1cf4e1bea3811de32a8e3322b242652b29 (normal merge; RapidRoom conflict resolution with Claude)
notes: Adopts the Immich library section, the global job tracker for exports, imports, transfers and AI work, background AI regeneration of masks, maps and denoise, DirectML/CoreML acceleration, EfficientSAM3/BiRefNet sky and foreground masks plus text and face masks, non-destructive BM3D denoise, the storage page with cache limits, decode fingerprints for the decoded-image cache, the rewritten shader noise reduction and sharpening, and the rewritten RAW preprocessing colour noise reduction. Every upstream sidecar writer goes through RapidRoom's locked atomic writer (with the #416 guard); sidecars holding only defaults are never deleted. Keeps the RapidRoom denoise queue and Apple RAW 9 denoise, the [0,1] AI denoise clamp, batch and auto lens, stacks, card mode, Instagram export and the reference view. Upstream's split and side-by-side compare modes are not taken yet. Upstream rendering changes were tested upstream; the new reference is blessed separately with Josh's standing approval for upstream syncs.
